source.selection_provenance: publication-selected topology after training, held-out temporal perturbations, and HSPG perturbation; not selected by Bio Chi outcome

equilibrium.rule: source initial state with fgf_input=0 and all activated/bound states zero

jacobian.method: centered finite difference of the source equations

measurement_observability.deterministic_measurement: source FRET equation without measurement-noise draw
measurement_observability.C: numerical gradient of deterministic FRET measurement at the same equilibrium

scalar_candidate_rule.eligible_pair: stable complex-conjugate pair that is numerically matched across all Jacobian steps and has measurement visibility >= 1e-8
scalar_candidate_rule.if_exactly_one: report model-specific candidate chi_bio = -Re(lambda)/|lambda|; do not admit

known_bad.real_diagonal_stable_generator: must yield zero complex pairs and scalar refusal

claim_ceiling: P0-Q model-specific ERK modal qualification or refusal only. No biological scalar admission, no universal chi, no chi=1 boundary, and no Bio Chi conglomerate claim.
next_if_unique_pair: freeze a separate trajectory-level same-mode qualification against already-reproduced Figure 2 groups without changing pair or fit rule
next_if_refused: retain the complete ERK modal result as Chi_bio Limit Map evidence and continue Bio Chi system-level work without scalar rescue
